===============================================================================
 B u i l d i n g   E x t e r n a l s
===============================================================================

Convention:

--------------
Configurations
--------------
Only the used solution/project configurations are maintained.
That is, if a project has 10 configurations and we only use
'Static Unicode Debug' and 'Static Unicode  Release', we will only maintain
these project configurations.
Other configurations should be presumed broken.


-------------
x64 and win32
-------------
All 64-bit binaries are appended with _64 in addition to conventional
suffixes. e.g. libpng_64.lib, libpngd_64.lib
Win32 binaries have no platform-specific suffix. e.g. libpng.lib, libpngd.lib

to switch between 32-bit and 64-bit targets select the 'Win32' or 'x64' from
the 'Solution Platforms' combo box . In most cases you will end up building
four sets of binaries 'Debug 32', 'Debug 64', 'Release 32', and 'Release 64'.


--------------------
Directory Structure:
--------------------
<UE3> denotes the location of the Unreal Engine 3 directory.
Let <UE3DevExt> denote <UE3/Development/External>

Relevant directory layout
<UE3>
 +---Binaries                        
     +---Win32                       # 32-bit exe, DLLs, and corresponding PDBs
     +---x64                         # 64-bit exe, DLLs, and corresponding PDBs
 +---Development
     +---External                    # 3rd party libraries; a.k.a <UE3DevExt>
         +---Bink
         +---FaceFX
         +---FCollada-3.05B
         +---libogg-1.1.3
         +---libPNG
         +---libvorbis-1.1.2
         +---lzopro
         +---nvTextureTools-2.0.4
         +---nvTriStrip
         +---PhysX
         +---SpeedTreeRT
         +---TestTrack
         +---tinyXML
         +---wxWidgets
         etc
         ...
         

- - - - - - - -
libpng and zlib
- - - - - - - -
            Solution:   <UE3DevExt>/libPNG/projects/msvc2005/libpng.sln
    Configs to Build:   LIB Release
                        LIB Debug
         Output Type:   Static Libs
         Output Dirs:   <UE3DevExt>/libPNG/lib    
               Notes:   Zlib is built as a prerequisite for libpng.


- - - - -
FCollada
- - - - -
            Solution:   <UE3DevExt>/FCollada-3.05B/FCollada/FCollada.sln
    Configs to Build:   Debug Unicode
                        Release Unicode
         Output Type:   Static Libs
         Output Dirs:   <UE3DevExt>/FCollada-3.05B/lib/release
                        <UE3DevExt>/FCollada-3.05B/lib/debug
  

- - - - - - - -
nvTextureTools
- - - - - - - -
            Solution:   <UE3DevExt>/nvTextureTools-2.0.4/src/project/vc8/nvtt.sln
    Configs to Build:   Release
                        (Debug to ensure it builds)
         Output Type:   DLL + Static Lib
          Output Dir:   <UE3DevExt>/nvTextureTools-2.0.4/release.win32
                        <UE3DevExt>/nvTextureTools-2.0.4/release.x64
         Manual Step:   Copy dlls and corresponding pdbs from the output directories
                        to <UE3>/Binaries/Win32/ and <UE3>/Binaries/Win64/
               Notes:   Requires CUDA SDK and Toolkit.
                        "Release Win32" requires the Win32 version of CUDA SDK/Toolkit to be installed.
                        "Release x64" requires the Win64 version of CUDA SDK/Toolkit to be installed.
                        The SDK/Toolkit installs cannot co-exist.


- - - 
ogg
- - -
            Solution:   <UE3DevExt>/libogg-1.1.3/win32/ogg.sln
    Configs to Build:   Release
                        Debug
         Output Type:   Static Lib + DLL
         Output Dirs:   <UE3>/Binaries/Win32
                        <UE3>/Binaries/Win64
                        <UE3DevExt>/libogg-1.1.3/win32/Debug
                        <UE3DevExt>/libogg-1.1.3/win32/Release
                        <UE3DevExt>/libogg-1.1.3/win32/x64/Debug
                        <UE3DevExt>/libogg-1.1.3/win32/x64/Release                        
               Notes:   DLLs are output directly to <UE3>/Binaries/Win32/ and <UE3>/Binaries/Win64/


- - - -
vorbis
- - - -
            Solution:   <UE3DevExt>/libvorbis-1.1.2/win32/vorbis.sln
    Configs to Build:   Release
                        Debug
         Output Type:   Static Lib + DLL
         Output Dirs:   <UE3>/Binaries/Win32/
                        <UE3>/Binaries/Win64/
                        <UE3DevExt>/libvorbis-1.1.2/win32/Debug
                        <UE3DevExt>/libvorbis-1.1.2/win32/Release
                        <UE3DevExt>/libvorbis-1.1.2/win32/x64/Debug
                        <UE3DevExt>/libvorbis-1.1.2/win32/x64/Release                        
               Notes:   DLLs are output directly to <UE3>/Binaries/Win32/ and <UE3>/Binaries/Win64/.
                        Depends on libogg.
               Hacks:   For x64, "C/C++ | Output Files | Object File Name" must be "$(IntDir)\". Notice the "\" at the end!


- - - - - 
wxWidgets
- - - - - 
            Solution:   <UE3DevExt>/wxWidgets/build/msw/wx_dll.sln
    Configs to Build:   DLL Unicode Release
                        DLL Unicode Debug
         Output Type:   Static Libs 
                        DLLs + Static Libs
         Output Dirs:   <UE3>/Binaries/Win32
                        <UE3>/Binaries/Win64
                        <UE3DevExt>/wxWidgets/lib/vc_dll/win32
                        <UE3DevExt>/wxWidgets/lib/vc_dll/x64
               Notes:   Outputs dlls, pdbs directly into <UE3>/Binaries/Win32/ and <UE3>/Binaries/Win64/

lzopro
- - - - 
            Solution:   none;  See <UE3DevExt>/README.1ST for build instructions
              Output:   Static Lib
         Output Dirs:   <UE3DevExt>/lzopro/lib

                        Microsoft Visual Studio 8\VC\bin\amd64\vcvarsamd64.bat
